name: Simutrans
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Simutrans, the free transport tycoon game, as a multiplayer server. Builds the headless server with the pak64 graphics set; the game is saved when the server stops and picked up again at the next start.
startup:
pw="{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}"; [ -n "$pw" ] || pw=$(od -An -N12 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d " 
"); a=(); [ "{{PUBLIC}}" = 1 ] && a=(-announce -server_name "{{SERVER_NAME}}"); (trap "" INT TERM; exec ./simutrans -server {{SERVER_PORT}} -objects {{PAKSET}}/ -singleuser -nosound -nomidi -lang en -server_admin_pw "$pw" "${a[@]}") & pid=$!; n() { ./nettool -q -s 127.0.0.1:{{SERVER_PORT}} -p "$pw" "$@"; }; trap "(n force-sync; sleep 5; n shutdown; sleep 60; kill -KILL \$pid) >/dev/null 2>&1 &" INT TERM; until n clients >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done; kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null && echo "Simutrans is ready for players on port {{SERVER_PORT}}."; wait $pid; wait $pid

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Simutrans. Its Linux release needs a desktop (SDL and a sound server), so
# this builds the headless server and its nettool admin tool from the
# release's source, with the game's data from the same source, then adds the
# pak64 graphics set from SourceForge, checked against its checksum. Your
# game (server<port>-network.sve), saves and other paksets are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build"

want=${VERSION:-latest}
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    # GitHub's latest release is the nightly build; the newest numbered
    # release is the newest folder on SourceForge (125-0-1 is 125.0.1).
    want=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://sourceforge.net/projects/simutrans/rss?path=/simutrans" |
        grep -oE '<title><!\[CDATA\[/simutrans/[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)+/' | sed -n 1p | grep -oE '[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)+' | tr - .) || want=
    [ -n "$want" ] || fail "SourceForge can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
fi
tag=$(gh-release tag simutrans/simutrans "$want") ||
    fail "Simutrans ${VERSION} doesn't exist. Check Version and reinstall."

if [ -x simutrans ] && [ -x nettool ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Simutrans $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Simutrans $tag's source"
    mkdir -p "$build/src"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://github.com/simutrans/simutrans/archive/refs/tags/$tag.tar.gz" |
        tar -xz -C "$build/src" --strip-components=1 || fail "The download from GitHub failed. Reinstall to try again."
    # The release's revision, which the server reports to players and the
    # server list (the source archive doesn't carry it).
    rev=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://github.com/simutrans/simutrans/releases/tag/$tag" | grep -oE '\br[0-9]{4,6}\b' | sed -n 1p | tr -d r) || rev=
    echo "Installing the build tools"
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    { apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends g++ cmake ninja-build pkg-config \
        zlib1g-dev libbz2-dev libpng-dev libzstd-dev libfreetype-dev; } >"$build/apt.log" 2>&1 ||
        { tail -n 5 "$build/apt.log"; fail "The build tools couldn't be installed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    echo "Building the Simutrans server (a few minutes)"
    mkdir -p "$build/b"
    (cd "$build/b" && cmake -G Ninja -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D SIMUTRANS_BACKEND=none -D SIMUTRANS_USE_UPNP=OFF \
        -D SIMUTRANS_USE_FLUIDSYNTH_MIDI=OFF -D SIMUTRANS_USE_FONTCONFIG=OFF -D SIMUTRANS_USE_CCACHE=OFF \
        ${rev:+-D SIMUTRANS_USE_REVISION=$rev} "$build/src" &&
        cmake --build . --parallel "$(nproc)" --target simutrans nettool) >"$build/build.log" 2>&1 ||
        { tail -n 20 "$build/build.log"; fail "Simutrans didn't build. Reinstall to try again."; }
    [ -x "$build/b/simutrans/simutrans" ] && [ -x "$build/b/src/nettool/nettool" ] || fail "Simutrans' build made no server."
    # The game's own data (settings, translations, scripts, AI); config/ stays
    # as you changed it.
    d="$build/src/simutrans"
    for x in ai font music script text themes; do
        [ -d "$d/$x" ] || continue
        rm -rf "$x" && mv "$d/$x" "$x"
    done
    mkdir -p config
    (cd "$d/config" && find . -type f -print0) | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        [ -e "config/$f" ] || { mkdir -p "config/$(dirname "$f")" && mv "$d/config/$f" "config/$f"; }
    done
    mv -f "$build/b/simutrans/simutrans" simutrans
    mv -f "$build/b/src/nettool/nettool" nettool
    echo "$tag" > .raptor-version
fi

# pak64, Simutrans' standard graphics set, from SourceForge.
rss=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://sourceforge.net/projects/simutrans/rss?path=/pak64") ||
    fail "SourceForge can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
item=$(tr -d '\r\n' <<<"$rss" | sed 's#</item>#&\n#g' | grep -E '<link>[^<]*/simupak64-[0-9-]+\.zip/download</link>' | sed -n 1p)
url=$(sed -nE 's#.*<link>([^<]*/simupak64-[0-9-]+\.zip/download)</link>.*#\1#p' <<<"$item")
md5=$(sed -nE 's#.*<media:hash algo="md5">([0-9a-f]{32})</media:hash>.*#\1#p' <<<"$item")
[ -n "$url" ] && [ -n "$md5" ] || fail "SourceForge's file list had no pak64. Reinstall to try again later."
pak=${url%/download}; pak=${pak##*/}
if [ -f pak/ground.Outside.pak ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-pak64 2>/dev/null)" = "$pak" ]; then
    echo "pak64 ($pak) is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading pak64 ($pak)"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/pak.zip" "$url" || fail "The download from SourceForge failed. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$(md5sum "$build/pak.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$md5" ] || fail "The download didn't match SourceForge's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p "$build/pak"
    unzip -q "$build/pak.zip" -d "$build/pak"
    p=$(find "$build/pak" -name ground.Outside.pak -printf '%h\n' | sed -n 1p)
    [ -n "$p" ] || fail "The pak64 download has no pakset in it."
    rm -rf pak && mv "$p" pak
    echo "$pak" > .raptor-pak64
fi
echo "Installed Simutrans $tag with pak64."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Simutrans release, such as 125.0.1, or latest for the newest one. Players need the same release. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: 1 lists the server on Simutrans' server list so players find it; 0 keeps it unlisted.

variables.name: Pakset
variables.description: The folder of the graphics set the game uses: pak (pak64, installed) or one you upload. Players need the same pakset.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for nettool, Simutrans' admin tool (kick, ban, say). Empty uses a new random one at each start.
